text.p: Ireland wing back Jason McAteer was suspened three games on Friday as FIFA continued to crack down on violent play in World Cup qualifiers.
McAteer, who has already served one match, received the ban for assaulting an opponent during a group eight qualifier against Macedonia on April 2.
Macedonia's Mitko Stojkovski was also suspended two matches.
Joel Groff of Luxembourg was handed a two-game ban for kicking an opponent from behind against Israel on March 31.
Ecuador's Luis Capurro was suspended three matches for violent conduct during a qualifier against Peru on April 2.
Hong Kong's Chan Chi Keung and Thailand's Lonesawang were both suspended two matches for assault during their World Cup qualifier on April 30.
Canada's Paul Peschisolido will sit out two games for rough play in a match against El Salvador.
